gaps.title: Material cataloging omitted from application layer
gaps.jtbd: When uploading or retrieving materials, I want to associate them with categories and tags, so that the cataloging requirement of the system is fulfilled.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a material upload request containing category and tags, When it is saved, Then the MaterialEntity is correctly associated with the category and tag entities in the database.
gaps.reason: literal brief requirement: The brief requires 'каталогизации ... материалами' (cataloging materials). While the DB schema exists for categories/tags, MaterialEntity.java and MaterialService.java completely ignore these fields.

gaps.title: Missing authentication and authorization for management operations
gaps.jtbd: When performing management actions like creating or deleting protocols, I want the system to verify my identity and permissions, so that unauthorized users cannot alter critical epidemiological data.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given an unauthenticated request to a POST/PUT/DELETE endpoint, When the request is received, Then it is rejected with a 401 Unauthorized status.
gaps.reason: domain-standard expectation: The brief asks for a web system for 'управления' (managing) epidemiological data. Such a system intrinsically requires authentication/authorization to prevent unauthorized modifications to sensitive public health information.
